rule: An entry exists only for a camera whose feed city label is a state name. Its place is the nearest same-state GeoNames populated place with population >= 500 within radiusKm — unless a place at least 3x that place's population lies within 10 km, in which case that dominant city wins (continuous urban strips file under their dominant city). If no >= 500 place is in range, the nearest smaller same-state place within radiusKm. Every other camera — and any with no place in range — keeps its feed label.
